name: search_memory
description: Search stored personal knowledge by entity names, keywords, IPs, ports, project names, or exact commands using FTS5/BM25. Use relevant injected or recent context first; search when needed facts about past configuration, contacts, projects, or preferences are missing. For conceptual or relationship questions, prefer semantic_recall when available. Memory recall has a maximum of TWO attempts total: if this lookup has no useful result, try semantic_recall once if available and not already tried; do not loop through keyword variations or make a third recall attempt. For current time, reminders, alerts, or service status, use an appropriate available live tool rather than requiring a memory lookup first; memory may still supply a missing host, endpoint, or configuration. For verification questions such as 'did you save X?', explicitly report whether matching rows were found, what they contain, and their relevance. If available lookups return no useful matches, say so without inventing information. A failed lookup is not proof the information is absent; report the failure accurately.

query.description: Search term to find in stored memories
